ns2:section.sectionText: In this course, students will examine and learn how ?places? use media, geography, people, history, business, culture, and sports to brand themselves in the context of a global marketplace - with a particular focus on tourism experiences. Students will travel to London & Paris for the field study portion from 5/15/13 ? 5/30/13. The field study portion will be 1 credit offered through the Office of Continuing Education, and both portions of the course are required in order to earn the 3 combined credits. Registration requires permission of instructor. Applications available at http://studyabroad.illinois.edu.
